title: Single-mode magneto-Rayleigh-Taylor (MRT) growth on an initially solid Al liner
description: Ellison benchmark 1. Controlled single-mode MRT measurement: an initially solid aluminum liner with a seeded sinusoidal surface perturbation is imploded on the 20-MA, ~100-ns Z facility; the perturbation amplitude growth is measured radiographically. The simulation must reproduce the single-mode amplitude growth.

primary_source.paper: Measurements of magneto-Rayleigh-Taylor instability growth during the implosion of initially solid metal liners

setup.perturbation_note: single-mode sinusoidal seeds in the 25-400 um wavelength range

data.observable: seeded single-mode MRT perturbation amplitude vs time
